ai.title: Mobavenue AI Tech and MMA India Release AI Marketing Maturity Study; 84-88% of AI Adopters Report Medium-to-High Business Impact
ai.description: Mobavenue AI Tech Limited, in association with MMA India, released 'The AI Marketing Maturity Study' on 7th May, 2026, based on insights from 60+ senior marketing leaders across 11+ industry verticals. The study found that 84–88% of AI adopters are reporting medium-to-high business impact across key marketing functions. AI maturity was benchmarked across four pillars — Creative & Content, Measurement & Insights, Propensity Modelling, and Customer & Sales Journeys — with full-stack AI adoption ranging between 35% and 57%. The findings point to a broader industry shift from AI experimentation towards integrated, outcome-led operational systems.
